parameters.content:
## YKW 03 — payment rescue

Customer story:
1. Payment failed → verify not already paid
2. Load order/viewer → skip if no contact / already owns
3. DEMO: skip quiet-hours hold
4. Create resume offer link
5. **OpenRouter** personalises rescue copy (template fallback)
6. **Notify via API**
7. Wait ~1s (demo) → if still unpaid → PONA10 incentive → Notify

Send only via `/api/internal/notify` (email preferred, SMS fallback).
Needs: `OPENROUTER_*`, `YAKWETU_API_URL`, `INTERNAL_API_KEY`

parameters.url: ={{ ($env.YAKWETU_API_URL || 'http://sinema-api:3001') + '/api/internal/orders/' + encodeURIComponent($('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.properties?.orderId || $('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.orderId || 'latest') + '?userId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.userId || $('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.user_id || '') + '&email=' + encodeURIComponent($('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.properties?.email || $('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.email || '') + '&phone=' + encodeURIComponent($('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.properties?.phone || $('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.phone || '') + '&movieId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.properties?.movieId || '') + '&movieTitle=' + encodeURIComponent($('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.properties?.movieTitle || '') + '&name=' + encodeURIComponent($('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.properties?.name || $('Payment failed (RabbitMQ)').item.json.name || '') }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ userId: $('Order & viewer (storefront)').item.json.user.id, scenario: 'B', step: 'first', movieIds: $('Order & viewer (storefront)').item.json.order.movieIds, orderId: $('Order & viewer (storefront)').item.json.order.id, discountPct: 0, ttlMinutes: 1440 }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const rescue = $("Guard the copy").first().json;
const link = $input.first().json;
const message = `Still want ${rescue.title}, ${rescue.firstName}? Code PONA10 — KES ${link.totalKes} (10% off) for the next hour: ${link.url}`;
return [{ json: {
  ...link,
  userId: rescue.userId,
  orderId: rescue.orderId,
  phone: rescue.phone,
  email: rescue.email || '',
  name: rescue.name || rescue.firstName || '',
  channelPref: rescue.channelPref || rescue.channel_pref || 'both',
  subject: `10% off ${rescue.title} — ends in an hour`,
  scenario: 'B_incentive',
  message,
  filmTitle: rescue.title,
  title: rescue.title,
  firstName: rescue.firstName,
  priceKes: link.totalKes,
  totalKes: link.totalKes,
  discountPct: 10,
  ctaUrl: link.url,
  url: link.url,
  ctaLabel: 'Claim 10% off',
  imageUrl: rescue.imageUrl || null,
  badge: 'PONA10',
}}];
